study_design.target_population: Patients represented by the source hospital cohort with heart failure and recorded follow-up
study_design.estimand: association between baseline predictors and all-cause event hazard, plus absolute observed event risk by 180 days
study_design.inclusion: all 299 source records with nonmissing time and event

cox_proportional_hazards.interpretation: Hazard ratios are associational, per one sample standard deviation; calibration and discrimination are apparent, not external validation.

selection_and_transport.selection_bias: The public cohort is a convenience clinical sample; referral, care, and measurement processes are not fully observed.
selection_and_transport.representativeness: No sampling weights or external target-population benchmark are available, so transport beyond the source setting is unverified.
selection_and_transport.measurement_error: Single recorded baseline measures may contain biological and laboratory variation; no replicate-measure correction is possible.

provenance.citation: Heart Failure Clinical Records [Dataset]. (2020). UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5Z89R
provenance.version: UCI static archive snapshot; source file timestamp 2023-05-22
